title: Rapid-Fire Painting
content: Chilean street artistFabian Gaete Maureiracan bang out a painting in a minute.(Direct link to video) He blends gradations and knocks in forms with his fingers, and then saves the brush for birds and tiny details.FromBest of YoutubeandBoingBoingThe Chinese artists who mass-produce couch art in Dafen, China, are almost as fast: They can produce 20-30 paintings in a day. More at Spiegel Online's article: "Van Gogh from the Sweatshop"-------Thanks,Roger
